name: devinsight-dashboard
description: Live performance telemetry pipeline for the Godot game Ascent.

scripts.test:db: docker compose exec -T db psql -U postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q < supabase/tests/privileges.sql
scripts.check:regression:local: SUPABASE_URL=http://localhost:8080 SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY="$(docker compose exec -T ingest cat /keys/service-role.jwt)" node scripts/check-regression.mjs
scripts.db:migrate:local: docker compose exec -T -e PGOPTIONS='-c client_min_messages=warning' db psql -U postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q < supabase/schema.sql && docker compose kill -s SIGUSR1 rest
